svg.text: +12V also feeds J2 (door bus, after F1) and K1. U1's own LDO makes +3V3.
Polarity is set in the firmware; rails without a name are +3V3.
Isolated: the charger only lights U5's LED.
C6 100n from MAINS to 0 V. Firmware:
C7 100n at U2's VCC. 120R at each end (module + panel).
IR: EMITTER TO THE AC, RECEIVER FOR LEARNING
Emitter: tip +, sleeve -. About 22 mA peaks.

down (latched until 'Reset alarms'). For UPS / server
signal inputs only: 1 A, 30 V DC.
terminal row: wires enter from below (box slots at x -22, 0, +22)
upright in box P7, magnets at the right-hand end

5 V into U1: blocks back-feed from the USB port
IR emitter current, about 22 mA peak
I2C clock (50 kHz on the 0.5 m lead)
lower door contact, closed when shut
tray float switch, closes on water
AC socket live: optocoupler pulls low
12 V in: plug pack on the UPS-backed PDU (W8)
door bus W1 to the touchscreen
hot probes T4 T5 T6 on harness W2
Build: sockets for U1, then U3 and U2, then the terminal row. With U1 out, power J1: +5 V, +12 V on J2; fit U1: +3V3.
Keep the 12 V wiring on the board's door-side half; 1-Wire and I2C short and away from K1. Pull-ups and filters as drawn.
